title: Origins
summary: Twenty years later a storyteller tells how Wang Ping and his wife Qing Yi rose from famine relief in the cruel Empire Mountain Kingdom, let themselves be captured as part of a plan, toppled the tyrant and founded the Tianxing Empire. Great Zhou and Chenyun hire cultivators of the Qu clan to kill him, but they all die, and the Ran, Zhao and Sun clans ban every cultivator from mortal affairs. Within five years Tianxing unifies the land, but Wang Ping finds no children, an emptiness inside, and after ten more years gives up the throne. He returns to the Wang Residence and asks Wang Lin who he really is, and Wang Lin tells him the story of a young man from the Heng Yue Sect on Planet Suzaku. Wang Ping understands he was born from resentment and retires with Qing Yi to a mountain village, asking that his ashes be sent to his father and that his carvings be burned with him. Meanwhile Lei Daozi, an Illusory Yin envoy of the Thunder Celestial Temple, arrives to hunt the man impersonating an envoy and notices a mortal staying conscious under his divine sense.
